FEATURES

Spend, in order.

Three jobs your team should not be doing by hand.

01
Auto-categorisation

Every transaction is sorted the moment it lands, using the categories your team already reports on. Corrections teach the rules, so the ledger gets cleaner each month.

02
Duplicate detection

Ledgerly compares amount, merchant and timing to find charges that look like repeats. Suspects wait in one queue with the context needed to decide.

03
Month-end close

Work through exceptions once, then send a reconciled month to your ledger. No receipt hunts, no spreadsheet stitching, no waiting on the last card statement.

HOW IT WORKS
